verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a REST API (Records, Workflows, Webhooks) and serves llms.txt and Markdown versions of its docs. However, nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. Markdown reference pages and llms.txt are documentation indexes, not structured API specifications, so they do not satisfy the story.
